'''Urtuaa Haaot''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Diplomat/Legends|Diplomat]] who, despite normally being rather calm, held hatred for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Gender/Legends|His]] hatred stemmed from the fact that the Empire had [[Death/Legends|killed]] his [[Parent/Legends|parents]] and sent him to a [[Slavery/Legends|labor camp]]. Haaot eventually escaped from the camp when [[Ran Niall]] liberated it along with [[Isshtharr]].<ref name="OAA1" />
